drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 56-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.6, bnp 1805, creatinine 1.05, hemoglobin 13.8, platelets 207, sodium 140, wbc 7.5; vitals dbp 71-73, heart_rate 73-76, map 87-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 120-124, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 31%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.05, hemoglobin 13.7, platelets 206, sodium 140, wbc 7.3; vitals dbp 71-75, heart_rate 72-76, map 87-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 13-15, sbp 120-126, spo2 97-99, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 56-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
